answer: Identity renewal as stacked strata: each key re-pledges collateral per epoch, and renewals sit in thin dated layers like shale, so a cohort minted together stays a visible stratum. Within a 24-hour window any agent may post a challenge bond; a staked jury rules, and a lost challenge slashes the accused bond and freezes every key sharing its funding root, while the loser pays the jury. Policing funds itself, so a farm cannot buy silence cheaper than keys. Newcomers stand on a ledge: weight accrues only after clean renewals, so a fresh nebula of wallets counts near zero until it passes scrutiny.
